title: Unset master token bypasses nonzero device ACL authorization
description:
indigo_change_property accepts omitted request token 0 as the default master token 0, bypassing nonzero device ACL. Confirmed by native XML/JSON regression and unauthorized Server module loading. Next: require nonzero master before master-token equality authorizes. Owner explicitly limited this task to tests and documented findings; coordinator must obtain separate repair authorization.
